episodes.title: The Gander
episodes.summary: Dave encounters GaTa for the first time and learns the social dynamics of the rap world and under his tutelage, he attempts to score a feature verse from YG.

episodes.title: Dave's First
episodes.summary: Dave books his first live performance, but it's in the worst place imaginable. Meanwhile, Elz hesitantly agrees to DJ, and Mike shows Dave a new skin care routine.

episodes.title: Hypospadias
episodes.summary: Ally tries to open Dave up to new sexual experiences but inadvertently exposes his deepest, darkest insecurities. Dave asks his friends for advice about satiating Ally's newfound appetites.

episodes.title: Somebody...
episodes.summary: Exhausted from his soul crushing job, Mike takes a special interest in Dave's creative process. With nothing to lose, Dave adopts an extreme approach to gaining fame and recognition. GaTa introduces Elz to Trippie Redd.

episodes.title: Hype Man
episodes.summary: Dave has an opportunity to open for a big rapper, but his nerves cause him to spiral into an identity crisis. When Dave asks GaTa to act as his hype man, GaTa is forced to confront memories from his past and reveal his biggest secret to his new friends.

episodes.title: Talent Shows
episodes.summary: Dave is in Philly for his first concert ever, and the gang stays with his parents. After reuniting with his overnight camp friends, Dave ponders his artistic roots.

episodes.title: What Wood You Wear?
episodes.summary: Emma's car is broken into, and Elz tries to help her recover her laptop. In an effort to play his beats for Trippie, Elz ends up taking on a precarious task.

episodes.title: PIBE
episodes.summary: Dave meets with labels about a record deal, and ends up in the studio with Justin Bieber and Benny Blanco. After getting invited to his first Hollywood party, Dave rubs elbows with Kourtney Kardashian, while Ally and Elz get browned out.

episodes.title: Ally's Toast
episodes.summary: Dave and Ally attend her sister's wedding in Napa, and Ally wants to impress her family with the perfect maid of honor speech. Dave struggles to be a good boyfriend while negotiating a record deal.

episodes.title: Jail
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Dave is trapped in a prison of his own creation. Will he escape?

episodes.title: International Gander
episodes.summary: Dave's making a video that will vault him to global success, but he's forced to face reality as the project threatens to implode - and create an international incident.

episodes.title: Antsy
episodes.summary: Back home, Dave is trying to hold his own feet to the creative fire, but the world has conspired to throw every possible distraction at him - especially the fact that he's going to see Ally for the first time since they broke up.

episodes.title: The Observer
episodes.summary: Dave and Benny's friendship blossoms in strange and unexpected ways, leading them to confront questions of privilege, race, sexuality, and dermatology. Meanwhile, Mike's isolation deepens, and a chance encounter sheds light on the root of his anger.

episodes.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
episodes.summary: Dave meets NBA all-time leading scorer Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, but gaining his affection is not exactly a lay up.

episodes.title: Bar Mitzvah
episodes.summary: Dave and Elz's friendship is tested when they perform together at a Bar Mitzvah. GaTa has a night out.

episodes.title: Somebody Date Me
episodes.summary: Dave joins an exclusive online dating app and matches with a pop star. Technological courtship ensues, as Dave gets caught up in the excitement of a modern day romance.

episodes.title: Ad Man
episodes.summary: Dave and Emma reminisce about their advertising days while battling present day identity crises, at one of hip hop's largest showcases.

episodes.title: The Burds
episodes.summary: Dave has a professional set back and is forced to spend more time with his parents. Family time has never been more eye-opening.

episodes.title: Enlightened Dave
episodes.summary: Dave journeys to a legendary recording studio, hoping to break through his creative block, but he is forced to confront his greatest obstacle: his own ego.

episodes.title: Dave
episodes.summary: Dave releases his debut album Penith. The rest is history.

episodes.title: Texas
episodes.summary: Dave and the gang are on tour! First stop, Texas. Dave is looking for love, but Texas is looking for Lil Dicky.

episodes.title: Harrison Ave
episodes.summary: Back in his hometown of Philadelphia, Dave grapples with his romantic origin story, both in his art and in real life.

episodes.title: Hearsay
episodes.summary: The tour continues in Atlanta where an encounter with Rick Ross causes a chain reaction that requires Dave and GaTa's full attention.

episodes.title: Wisconsin
episodes.summary: Ally joins the tour to rekindle an old flame, while Dave looks to ignite a new one.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: Dave gets a lesson in Southern hospitality, courtesy of his number one fan.

episodes.title: #RIPLilDicky
episodes.summary: Dave makes a big decision about the tour, but it blows up in his face.

episodes.title: Rebirthday
episodes.summary: Dave's got a new lease on life, a new house and a new house guest. But his friends have other plans.

episodes.title: Met Gala
episodes.summary: Dave attends his first Met Gala, while Gata attends his first mental health panel.

episodes.title: Dream Girl
episodes.summary: Dave straddles the line between reality and fantasy as Emma's tour documentary is finally complete.

episodes.title: Looking for Love
episodes.summary: Dave's quest for love reaches its epic conclusion.
